description: The bar chart illustrates the F1 Score (%) performance of the MADLLM model and its ablated variants—MADLLM without feature embedding and MADLLM without skip embedding—across five different datasets or evaluation scenarios: PSM, SWaT, SMAP, and MSL (with one unlabeled gray bar at the far left, possibly representing a baseline or placeholder). The vertical axis ranges from 80% to 100% F1 Score, with tick marks at 80, 90, and 100. Each group of three bars corresponds to one dataset, with the green bar representing the full MADLLM model, the purple bar representing MADLLM without feature embedding, and the orange bar representing MADLLM without skip embedding. Across all datasets, the full MADLLM model consistently achieves the highest F1 Score, typically ranging from approximately 92% to 96%. The ablated versions generally underperform: “w/o feature embedding” scores between ~86% and 94%, while “w/o skip embedding” scores between ~86% and 93%. Notably, on the SWaT dataset, the performance drop is most pronounced for both ablated versions, with the “w/o feature embedding” variant falling to ~86%. The chart visually emphasizes the contribution of both feature and skip embeddings to the model’s overall effectiveness in multivariate anomaly detection.
